title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
statement_md:
You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the $i$-th day.

You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock.

Return the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction. If you cannot achieve any profit, return 0.

hints.text: Can you track the minimum price seen so far while iterating?
Every day you consider selling at `price`, compare with `min_price` to update `max_profit`.
Maintain `lowest = min(lowest, price)` and `best = max(best, price - lowest)`. Single pass.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: One-Pass Tracking

Keep track of the minimum price encountered so far. At each step, calculate the potential profit if sold today, updating maximum profit.

- Time Complexity: $O(n)$
- Space Complexity: $O(1)$
